# Getting started

Install the CLI with `npm i <pkg>` and read the [configuration guide](/docs/config).
Links to [`scan --json`](/docs/json) keep their code text. See <https://example.com>.

```html
<!-- Code samples are not scanned -->
<img src="logo.png">
<div onclick="go()">Go</div>
```
